name: Priya Mehta
short: I wasn’t just reacting to the moment any more. I had already chosen the frame.
full: Tarang had us in position by the Ken well before the tigress came down to drink. He talked us through the light and the background while we waited, so when she arrived I was calm. That one morning changed how I approach every sighting.

name: Arjun Nair
short: We went through every card at night. The next morning I knew exactly what to change.
full: The evening sessions at Naaharbagh made the trip for me. Honest feedback, practical edits, and no ego. By day three my keeper rate had doubled.

name: Sophie Laurent
short: We sat with the animals and made photographs rather than records.
full: Nobody rushed from one sighting to the next. We stayed with a pride for most of an afternoon and watched the light go. It was the most patient safari I have been on.

name: Rahul Deshpande
short: Breakfast in the bush, six people, and a guide who actually teaches.
full: Everything was arranged, so all I had to think about was the camera. I learned more about reading behaviour in four days than in a year of shooting on my own.
